package.name: ur_camera_gz
package.description: RealSense D435 description and gz-sim (Harmonic) sensor bridge, for mounting a wrist camera on the UR + gripper assemblies in ur_gripper_gz. Kept as its own package (perception) rather than folded into ur_gripper_gz (manipulation), and outside the ur_python_utilities/cartesian_controllers vendor clones since it is first-party code, not upstream.
